greeting: The First Progenitor on comms. Stage 1: The Garden of Origin. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Progenitor's Will. Objective drift gets teams buried.
Yesterday a corridor tried to charge me toll in riddles. I paid in sarcasm.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Meet the First Progenitor.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Meet the First Progenitor; Hear their story; Understand the true nature of the threat. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Meet the First Progenitor in their sanctuary. Immediate move: Meet the First Progenitor.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 1 resolved: The Garden of Origin. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Three Choices.
rumor: Palace mirrors reportedly show exits one breath before they open.
People keep repeating one clue from The Garden of Origin: 'Understand the true nature of the threat'.
I saw gravity file for overtime in this sector. Management approved.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn in the palace refracts through crystal halls; false routes are common.
dialog.time_noon: Noon activates old systems and old defenses. Assume every tile is listening.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk makes memory projections bolder. Do not negotiate with every ghost.
dialog.time_night: Night at the engine core is quiet and dangerous. Keep your purpose fixed.

party_reactions.kade: The First Progenitor sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for The First Progenitor accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: The First Progenitor talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Identify your lane and your fallback.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Good timing. We can still salvage this window.
relationship_dialog.friend: You know the drill. I trust your judgment.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: If the world bends, we bend it back together.
